title: roettlera nervosa
intro: Roettlera nervosa, commonly known as the Nervous Plant or Electric Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety and stress, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. Roettlera nervosa is believed to exert its therapeutic actions through its bioactive constituents, which may include alkaloids and flavonoids that can act as antioxidants and anxiolytics. However, further research is needed to fully understand the plant's properties and potential uses.
